title: Yandex suspends turnkey data-labeling service on Yandex Tasks for external clients
summary: Yandex suspended full-service turnkey data annotation on Yandex Tasks for external commercial clients to redirect resources to internal AI development, while retaining self-service platform access for independent task and worker management.
research_notes:
Create a commercial customer account on the Yandex Tasks platform to access self-service data labeling tools.

Configure task templates, annotation guidelines, and acceptance rules directly within the self-service interface without vendor assistance.

Assign tasks to independent freelance crowd workers and manage task validation and compensation directly.

Embed automated honeypots and consensus-based validation rules in self-managed task templates to replace discontinued vendor quality assurance.

Combine synthetic data pre-labeling with targeted human-in-the-loop validation to minimize reliance on external crowd annotation capacity.
